pages.name: Werewolf
pages.text: Werewolf. A cursed hunter with a wolf’s jaws and a human’s cruelty.

pages.title: Habitat
pages.text: Forests and taiga. By day it resembles a peaceful villager without trading. At night it becomes a Werewolf; dawn restores human form. Health preserves its fraction (20/120 HP). In skyless dimensions it stays a beast.

pages.title: Claws and bite
pages.text: Two claw hits deal 9 and 11 damage. Below 60 percent health a third strike joins the combo. Bite deals 13 damage and briefly slows the target.

pages.title: Three phases
pages.text: Hunt: 120–72 HP. Below 72 HP it gains leaps and charges. Below 30 HP it howls once and enters rage: speed, 20 percent extra damage, up to four 1-HP heals at three-second intervals.

pages.title: Leap and charge
pages.text: Leap prepares for 0.7 seconds; charge for 0.5. The direction is fixed. Step aside. A miss leaves a counterattack window: 25 percent extra incoming damage for one second.

pages.title: Interruption
pages.text: During leap or charge preparation, a player hit removing at least 6 HP has a 35 percent chance to interrupt. Stun lasts 0.9 seconds; repeat interruption is blocked for eight seconds.

pages.title: Alchemy and loot
pages.text: Cursed oil: 20 percent extra damage for 30 hits. Elixir: 25 percent for 180 seconds. Essence: 100 percent, 1–2. Claw: 40 percent. Head: 15 percent with a player or tamed ally’s killing blow.

pages.title: Hunter’s advice
pages.text: Keep away from the jaws. During preparation either strike hard or sidestep. Punish a missed rush. Use oil in rage and do not let healing prolong the fight.
